content.text: How do I fix the Docker memory issue with the batch watcher?
The Docker container was limited to 2GB. You need to increase the memory limit in docker-compose.yaml to at least 4GB for the batch watcher service.
What about the Qdrant container memory?
Qdrant typically uses about 500MB for small collections. Set the memory limit to 1GB to be safe. Check docker stats to monitor actual usage.
